author: Russell Brand
description:
A viral clash over dogs, Islam, and city life spirals into a broader culture war debate. From comments about dogs being “unclean” to outrage from politicians and streamers, this segment looks at how even pets have become ideological battlegrounds. What starts as a sanitation gripe in New York turns into a reflection on polarization, decentralization, and whether modern politics can survive when everything becomes tribal. If we can’t agree on dogs, what can we agree on?
